theme_strategy: Light mode primary for both Student and Admin to convey clarity, authority, and distraction-free focus. Dark mode toggle available only for Admin. Pure stark white for Student exam canvas.

fonts.heading: Work Sans
fonts.instruction: Do not use Inter. Work Sans provides authoritative yet accessible headings. IBM Plex Sans provides excellent legibility for long exam questions. IBM Plex Mono for large timers and TKJ code snippets.

colors.rules: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action or indicate status (e.g., green for 'Tersimpan ✓', red for 'Pelanggaran'). No full-screen gradients.

participant_landing.left: Minimalist form (Nama, Sekolah, Kelas, Token). Clean input fields with clear labels, huge spacing (p-12).
participant_landing.right: Full height student image with soft brand overlay (bg-black/30). Covers entirely without gaps.

participant_exam.grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 p-6 md:p-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
participant_exam.main_content: col-span-full md:col-span-9. Left-aligned question text, massive radio buttons for choices.
participant_exam.sidebar: col-span-full md:col-span-3. Contains large timer, 'Sesi Diawasi' camera preview (top right), and Question Navigation Grid.
participant_exam.header: Minimalist header with massive Progress Bar spanning full width at the very top (h-2 or h-3).

admin_dashboard.sidebar: 256px fixed width, pure white surface, 1px right border.
admin_dashboard.content: Top KPI metric strip (4 cards), followed by data tables spanning full width. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use CSS Grid for complex stats.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI primarily. DO NOT build complex components from scratch.
Radio Group (For TKJ & DISC): Use massive, easily clickable radio cards instead of tiny native radio circles. Add `hover:bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200` to the label container.
Progress Bar: Height must be prominent (e.g., `h-3`), fixed at top. Use Shadcn Progress.
Camera Preview Box: Square, fixed aspect ratio, with a red pulsing 'Sesi Diawasi' badge overlaid. Flat design, no glassmorphism.
Question Grid: Small square buttons (`w-10 h-10`). Gray/Outline for unanswered, Solid Dark Blue/Black for answered, subtle ring for current.
Admin Tables: Dense, border-collapse style with row hover effects. Include robust filters.
DISC Choice Interface: Forced choice requires distinct visual separation for 'Paling' (Most) and 'Kurang' (Least) across 4 statements. Use a dedicated card interface.

overrides.cards: For Student UI, use 'cardless' or perfectly flat surfaces with 1px `border-zinc-200` and no shadow to maintain a stark, focused environment. Admin cards can have subtle `shadow-sm`.
overrides.inputs: Height `h-12` for participant forms, large text (text-lg).

rules: Exam UI: Almost zero motion to prevent distraction. Only instant feedback or micro-transitions on radio selection.
Admin UI: Standard smooth transitions (`transition-transform 0.2s ease`).
Camera Badge: A subtle pulse animation (`animate-pulse`) on a tiny red dot next to 'Sesi Diawasi'.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for their precise, clean aesthetic that matches the Swiss style. Keep icons minimal in the exam view.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Admin tables. Solid Background for everything else. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds over content.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AA. Text must be `text-zinc-900` on white. Placeholder text `text-zinc-500`.
accessibility.interactions: All choices in TKJ and DISC must have a large hit area (entire card clickable).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:outline-none`) on all interactive elements.

media.rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Always use provided Unsplash images.

landing_hero.description: Student intensely focused, representing the calm but serious nature of the exam. Use on the right side of the split-screen participant login.

admin_abstract_bg.description: Abstract secure tech node network. Can be used subtly for admin login background or empty states.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep student exam view strictly flat.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Never use generic centered layouts for long text; left-align exam questions for readability.
Ensure 'Tersimpan ✓' autosave indicator is clearly visible without being annoying.
Do not build HTML-based complex components. Use Shadcn for Select, Dropdown, Table, and Progress.
All .js/jsx files should follow clean, modern React patterns.
